headline: ‘NAZA,’ Israeli Film About Killings in Gaza, Faces Backlash
context: The film “NAZA” investigates the killing of Palestinians by Israeli forces in Gaza. Israel’s culture minister has suggested revoking the directors’ citizenship.

sources.name: The New York Times
